judgement.note: A block passes when the mean credit of its cues (a tap that is hit counts 1, a hold counts the share of its length held) is at least pass_credit. windows_ms are the hit windows around a cue time, hold_complete_s how close to its tail a hold may be released and still count whole. All tunable.

energy.note: energy += pass_gain + pass_bonus*(credit-pass_credit)/(1-pass_credit) on a pass, -= fail_loss*(pass_credit-credit)/pass_credit+3 on a fail; it ends the run at 0. Seven blocks in a row at credit 0 are needed to end a run from a fresh start.

track.note: Track scenes only (docs/RUN_TRACK_SCENES.md "Energy"): a track scene plays about four laps, so four times the blocks of a scene; these are a quarter of the numbers above (fail_flat is the fixed +3 of a fail), so a player of a given accuracy survives about as many scenes as before (bot players over 24 seeds, docs/HANDOVER.md A12's method). A block without cues gives nothing.

mix.note: The audio polish (docs/HANDOVER.md 'Audio polish'): gain_db = the run's level on RunMix; bass_bus = the bass voice's tone bus (high-pass, low shelf, WAVESHAPE drive with pre and post gain; a path's run.json mix and a scene's music.json bass_bus override it key by key; enabled false = off); recipe_bass_floor lifts an arrangement recipe's bass gain in the run; carry_bass = the previous scene's bass under the drums-alone block when both scenes play one music family (gain 0 = off); dip_gain / dip_beats = a hotspot's music dip. Before the polish: no gain, no bass bus, no floor, no carry, dip 0.35 for 8 beats, stage 2 bass 0.5, stage 3 synth 0.6.
